name: ebb
description: Electron Black-Box (EBB) test harness - Playwright-driven, with a dependency-free DevTools Protocol fallback

comments.dependency-policy: playwright-core is the only dependency on purpose. It must be `playwright-core` and not `playwright`, because the harness drives the application's own Electron binary and therefore never needs bundled browsers. Every part of the harness except the Playwright driver keeps working when node_modules is absent, so the process can still run before any install has succeeded.
